data.name: Mahban
data.gender_notes: Mahban is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mahabbah', meaning 'love'. Mahban signifies a compassionate friend or someone who embodies love and kindness. The name Mahban carries the meaning “Compassionate friend” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahban usually hope their child will grow to embody compassionate friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Mahban represents the bond of love and friendship between believers, reflecting the Hadith 'The believer to the believer is like a building, each part strengthens the other.'
data.etymology: Mahban belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Compassionate friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahban total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
